en.headline: Tai Lam property owner fined HK$255,800 for ignoring removal order
en.dek: The Buildings Department said the owner of a detached house was prosecuted after repeatedly failing to demolish unauthorised structures covering more than 170 square metres.
body: A property owner has been fined a total of HK$255,800 for persistently failing to comply with a removal order for unauthorised building works at a detached house in Tai Lam, the Buildings Department said on Tuesday.

The case was heard at the Tuen Mun Magistrates’ Courts on Friday. Of the fine, HK$155,880 related to the number of days the offence continued. The unauthorised works included an illegal platform of about 122 square metres on a slope adjoining an approved garden, a floor slab erected over a void next to the dining room, removal of parts of external walls, and unauthorised structures extending floors at different levels with a total area of about 57 square metres.

The works were carried out without prior approval, and a removal order was served. The owner had been prosecuted seven times previously, resulting in fines and a four-month prison sentence suspended for two years. A Buildings Department spokesman said the department would continue stringent enforcement and further prosecutions against owners who persist in not complying with removal orders to ensure building and public safety.

Under the Buildings Ordinance, failure to comply with a removal order without reasonable excuse carries a maximum penalty of a HK$200,000 fine and one year’s imprisonment, plus a daily fine of up to HK$20,000.

zh.headline: 大欖獨立屋業主拒拆僭建罰款25.58萬元
zh.dek: 屋宇署表示，一名獨立屋業主多次未遵從清拆令，涉事僭建物總面積逾170平方米，上周五在屯門裁判法院被定罪罰款。
body: 屋宇署周二表示，一名大欖獨立屋業主因持續不遵從清拆令，被罰款合共255,800元。
案件上周五在屯門裁判法院審理，其中155,880元屬就罪行持續日數所判的罰款。僭建物包括毗鄰認可花園的斜坡上約122平方米非法平台、飯廳旁空隙上方搭建的樓板、拆除部分外牆，以及在不同樓層加建總面積約57平方米的僭建物。
有關工程未獲事先批准，屋宇署已發出清拆令。該業主曾七次被檢控，被判罰款及緩刑兩年的四個月監禁。屋宇署發言人表示，署方會繼續嚴厲執法，對持續不遵從清拆令的業主再提出檢控，以保障樓宇及公眾安全。
根據《建築物條例》，無合理辯解而不遵從清拆令屬嚴重罪行，一經定罪最高可罰款20萬元及監禁一年，並可就持續日數另判每日最高2萬元罰款。
